Years of reading and writing about literature shape how I think about language, story, and the way a brand speaks to its audience.

I’m Ayana Raj, a content and media professional with a background in English literature and a growing interest in the many ways ideas can take shape.

From writing a blog to developing a campaign concept or working on a video, I enjoy the process of figuring out not just what to communicate, but how to make it worth someone’s attention.

My experience at Webfolks has allowed me to work across content writing, SEO, social media, brand communication, and creative production. Working across these areas has taught me to look beyond the words on a page and think about the bigger picture: the audience, the message, the medium, and the details that bring everything together.

I’m drawn to work that gives me room to think, experiment, and build something with intention. As I continue developing my career, I’m interested in exploring new teams, fresh perspectives, and opportunities that let me grow further in content, digital media, and video editing.
